title: Did you know… clarity often comes after obedience, not before?
paragraphs: Did you know… clarity often comes after obedience, not before?

You’re waiting for the full map…
God is asking for your next step.

Because obedience feels blind. Risky. Uncomfortable.
Like walking into fog with nothing but a whisper.

In Isaiah 30:21 it says,
“Your ears shall hear a word behind you, saying, ‘This is the way, walk in it.’”

We want clarity, then obedience.
God commands obedience, then gives clarity.

That’s where pride dies.
That’s where control breaks.
And yes… that’s where fear screams the loudest.
Delayed obedience is often disguised disobedience.

Because obedience might cost you something:
Comfort.
Reputation.
A relationship.
A hidden sin you’re not ready to surrender.
And that’s where grace walks in.
Jesus didn’t wait for you to “figure it out” before He moved.

While you were still lost…
Still messy…
Still unsure…
So maybe the breakthrough you’re praying for…
Is sitting on the other side of one hard “yes” to God.

Forgive.
Let go.
Turn away.
Speak truth.
Come back.

Clarity follows obedience.
Because obedience aligns you with the voice of God.

From confusion to calling—
because Jesus still leads those who follow.
